title: Session management based network slice admission control

entities.name: Network Slice Admission Control
entities.description: Procedure performed by SMF to monitor and control the total number of established PDU sessions per network slice based on S-NSSAI.

entities.name: PDU Session Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing a PDU session where network slice admission control is performed.

entities.name: Allowed PDU session status IE
entities.description: Information element used when UE requests to transfer a session from non-3GPP access to 3GPP access.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information used to identify network slices.

entities.name: Maximum PDU sessions reached
entities.description: Condition where the maximum number of PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been reached.

entities.name: SMF rejects request
entities.description: Behavior where SMF rejects PDU session establishment request or user-plane resource establishment request when maximum PDU sessions are reached.

entities.name: PDU session for emergency services
entities.description: Condition where PDU session is used for emergency services, making network slice admission control not applicable or its result ignored.

entities.name: PDU session for priority services
entities.description: Condition where PDU session is used for priority services, making network slice admission control not applicable or its result ignored.

entities.name: PDU session for onboarding services in SNPN
entities.description: Condition where PDU session is established for onboarding services in SNPN, making network slice admission control not applicable.

relations.description: Network slice admission control is performed during PDU session establishment procedure.
Network slice admission control is performed on S-NSSAI.
When maximum PDU sessions are reached, SMF rejects the request.
Network slice admission control is performed when UE requests session transfer using Allowed PDU session status IE.
Network slice admission control is not applicable or its result is ignored for emergency services PDU sessions.
Network slice admission control is not applicable or its result is ignored for priority services PDU sessions.
Network slice admission control is not applicable for onboarding services PDU sessions in SNPN.
